risks.risk: The panels may be counterfeit or have significantly lower wattage than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label on the back of the panels.

risks.risk: The panels may be non-functional or have degraded output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc).

risks.risk: The battery mentioned in the description may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery and a video showing it being charged and tested.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the back of the panels to confirm the brand and wattage.
Photo of the battery if it is included.
Video of a multimeter test showing the open-circuit voltage (Voc) and short-circuit current (Isc).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
